ex.en: Did you go to the art exhibition?
ex.zh: 你去看那場藝術展覽了嗎？

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這場展覽引起了大眾的高度關注。

ex.en: The exhibition is now open.
ex.zh: 展覽現在開放了。

ex.en: More than 500 exhibitors took part in the fair.
ex.zh: 超過 500 家參展商參加了這次展覽。

ex.en: Exhibitors can set up their booths on Monday.
ex.zh: 參展商星期一可以布置攤位。

ex.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.
ex.zh: 我這個月要減少開支。

ex.en: I have run out of my traveling expenses.
ex.zh: 我的旅費用完了。

ex.en: One thousand dollars will cover all the expenses for the party.
ex.zh: 一千美元足以支付派對的所有費用。

expense.zh: at the expense of：以…為代價；由…出錢

ex.en: He did it at the expense of his health.
ex.zh: 他以犧牲自己的健康為代價完成了這項工作。

ex.en: I had a good dinner at his expense.
ex.zh: 他請我吃了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

ex.en: Passengers with excess baggage have to pay an additional charge.
ex.zh: 行李超重的旅客必須支付額外費用。

ex.en: How much is the fee for excess baggage on this flight?
ex.zh: 這個航班的超重行李費是多少？

ex.en: Weigongcun subway station has three exits.
ex.zh: 魏公村地鐵站有三個出口。

ex.en: Where is the emergency exit?
ex.zh: 緊急出口在哪裡？

ex.en: If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.
ex.zh: 有緊急情況時，一定要從這個出口逃出屋外。

ex.en: Please exit the building by the rear door.
ex.zh: 請從後門離開大樓。

ex.en: Exit the app and open it again.
ex.zh: 先關閉這個 App，再重新打開。

ex.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
ex.zh: 旅行社會幫你安排一趟安達盧西亞之旅。

ex.en: We went on a day excursion to the lake.
ex.zh: 我們去湖邊一日遊。

ex.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.
ex.zh: 考慮到他缺乏經驗，他已經做得非常好了。

ex.en: I don't think that Tom has any teaching experience.
ex.zh: 我認為湯姆一點教學經驗都沒有。

ex.en: Tom encouraged Mary to write about her experiences.
ex.zh: 湯姆鼓勵瑪麗寫下她的經歷。

ex.en: Did you have a lot of happy experiences in your childhood?
ex.zh: 你小時候是不是有很多快樂的經歷呢？

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年我們經歷了很多變化。

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們感受到了勝利的喜悅。

ex.en: My passport has expired.
ex.zh: 我的護照過期了。

ex.en: Your driver's license has expired.
ex.zh: 你的駕駛執照已經過期了。

ex.en: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
ex.zh: 如果簽證過期，你就必須離開中國。

ex.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.
ex.zh: 老師向我們解釋了這個字的意思。

ex.en: Would you mind explaining this?
ex.zh: 你介意解釋一下嗎？

ex.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentences.
ex.zh: 他解釋了句子的字面意思。

ex.en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.
ex.zh: 政府的支出有點過多。

ex.en: We need to reduce our expenditure on travel.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少差旅支出。

ex.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
ex.zh: 我認識了那位執行長。

ex.en: She is a senior executive at a tech company.
ex.zh: 她是一家科技公司的高階主管。

ex.en: I trust his executive ability.
ex.zh: 我相信他的執行能力。

ex.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
ex.zh: 我們需要獵頭公司幫我們找到適合這個主管職位的人。

ex.en: Can you expedite the shipping? We need the parts by Monday.
ex.zh: 可以加快出貨嗎？我們星期一前需要零件。

ex.en: Paying an extra fee will expedite your visa application.
ex.zh: 多付一筆費用可以加快簽證申請的處理。

ex.en: Grace goes upstairs to the extension telephone.
ex.zh: 葛蕾絲上樓去接分機電話。

ex.en: Please call me at extension 205.
ex.zh: 請撥分機 205 找我。

ex.en: This extension cord is too short.
ex.zh: 這條延長線太短了。

ex.en: I need an extension cord.
ex.zh: 我需要一條延長線。

ex.en: I asked my professor for an extension on the paper.
ex.zh: 我向教授申請延後交報告。
